ui.core.title: ToME original-core integration
ui.core.mounting: Connecting the original source and asset files…
ui.core.starting: Starting the original module and character birth…
ui.core.diagnostic: This is a diagnostic projection of the original C/Lua core. It is not the complete game UI; original invisibility, ESP, dialogs and all content translations still require integration.
ui.core.loading: Waiting for the original core and original character birth…
ui.core.ready: Original character birth and starting level are ready.
ui.core.help: Arrow keys and the numeric keypad submit original movement actions. Keypad 5 waits. The original C/Lua core decides attacks, movement, energy and turns. Text entry, IME composition, repeat and modifier shortcuts are left alone.
ui.core.save_boundary: Original userdata and class graphs remain in the original core. This display snapshot is not a save file.
error.core.bytes: The core projection exceeds the supported transport size.
error.core.json: The original-core projection has an invalid JSON format.
error.core.protocol: The original-core bridge protocol is incompatible.
error.core.map: The core map projection has invalid dimensions or cell order.
error.core.number: The core projection contains an unsupported numeric value.
error.core.not_ready: Original character birth and starting level have not completed.
error.core.catalog: An adapter UI translation is missing or invalid.
error.core.request: The adapter request is invalid or contains unsupported fields.
error.core.busy: An original-core request is already in progress.
error.core.response: The original-core response does not match the pending request.
error.core.failed: The original core reported an error; its state was not replaced by a Rust simulation.
error.core.native_exports: The native runtime does not provide the required original-core bridge exports.
error.core.native_mount: The original source and asset files could not be connected to the native runtime.
error.core.native_init: The original native runtime could not be initialized. Reload to create a fresh runtime.
error.core.native_start: The original module or character birth could not be started. Reload to create a fresh runtime.
error.ui.unavailable: The retained original dialog bridge has not been installed.
error.ui.shape: This original UI component is not yet supported by the Rust presentation adapter.
error.ui.stale: The original dialog or component changed. Read its current view before acting.
error.ui.modal: Complete the active original dialog before sending gameplay input.
error.ui.text: The original UI text needs a semantic ID and matching translation parameters.
error.core.no_snapshot: No original-core snapshot has been received.
